rendering: headless Chromium software WebGL; 960x640 functional viewport
sensorSource: Generated DeviceMotion and matching DeviceOrientation at 16 ms; continuous 3 rad/s sine gestures with a 700 ms period and no rest interval
checks: Play joins and the leader starts a scored table-tennis motion game without a calibration checklist
An idle motion controller produces no automatic player hit or credited return
Y sideways continuous swings make at least three real contacts and legal opponent-table returns without a still-hand reset
Z screen-up continuous swings make at least three real contacts and legal opponent-table returns without a still-hand reset
Hidden controller stops pose delivery and foreground resumes only with fresh input
Sensor silence cancels delivery and fresh neutral samples recover without another permission prompt
The same controller can enter the twelve-point bot game
limitations: Continuous generated gestures validate software routing/contact/return; they are not a physical recognition-accuracy or latency benchmark.
No physical phone sensors, permission dialogs, grip comfort, haptics or full bot match are established.
